terms.gloss: a document, a file on a computer
terms.comment: Traupman’s word for a computer file, in the plural documenta or ācta (p. 315); an attachment is documentum annexum (p. 260). Classically a lesson or a proof (Lewis & Short), so it is not used for a paper document.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 260, 315, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
